svg.title: A04 conceptual research model
svg.desc: APOLLO SWARM SENTINEL: question, observables, model and validation. Proposed design; no measured results.
svg.text: Which local sensing and communication rules permit reliable target detection despite
asynchronous activation, sensor noise, particle failures, and limited memory?
Formal model definitions, algorithmic primitives, and publication links.
G=(V,E) is the time-dependent adjacency graph of particles on a hexagonal baseline lattice.
Use invariant checking and model checking on small exhaustive systems before large simulations.
Conceptual design • proposed research • full equations, data access and uncertainty in the dossier
